name: F-16C Block 50 USAF Squadrons Skin Pack
summary: USAF F-16C Block 50 squadron liveries with improved default textures, by Texac.
description: USAF squadron liveries for the F-16C. The User Files download is only a README; the textures (Fighting_Falcon_Improved_Textures.zip) come from a MEGA link inside the PDF. Installs via JSGME or manually into `CoreMods\aircraft\F-16C\Liveries\F-16C_50` in the DCS install folder.
